# dte-sdk

> A TypeScript SDK (work in progress) for Chilean DTE (Documento Tributario Electrónico) as defined by the SII.

dte-sdk is currently a placeholder package. Its only export is `hello()`, which returns the string `'dte-sdk is coming'`. The DTE API will be added in future releases. The package is fully typed, tree-shakeable, supports both ESM and CommonJS, and runs in Node.js (>= 20), the browser, Deno, and Bun.

Key technical details:
- **Zero dependencies**: Pure TypeScript implementation
- **Dual package**: Native ESM with CommonJS fallback
- **Type definitions**: Full TypeScript support

## Getting Started

- [Package on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dte-sdk): npm registry page with version history
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/arrowsw/dte-sdk): Source code, issues, and contribution guidelines
- [README](https://github.com/arrowsw/dte-sdk/blob/canary/README.md): Quick reference with code examples

## API

- `hello(): string` — returns `'dte-sdk is coming'`
